extracted_terms.description: Advance payment condition required prior to kickoff

conflicts.description: Initial price gap (₹75,000 vs ₹1,50,000) resolved to ₹1,00,000 but qualified by ambiguous acceptance statement

party_positions.Raj Mehta: Budget ₹75,000 initially; conceded to ₹1,00,000 stating 'Sure, that works I think. Let's go ahead'
party_positions.Priya Sharma: Demanded ₹1,50,000; agreed to ₹1,00,000 conditioned strictly on 50% upfront

conflicts.resolution_suggestion: Formally confirm consideration at ₹1,00,000 with ₹50,000 paid upon signing.
conflicts.statutory_context: Indian Contract Act, 1872 Section 7: Acceptance must be absolute and unqualified. The phrase 'that works I think' introduces legal ambiguity.
